notes.title: Phil Alone - Game Dev Book!
notes.content:
[h1]Phil Alone - Game Dev Book[/h1]

[h3] "A way to say “Thank You” to every player of Phil Alone - Gabriel Dias" [/h3]

A new booklet of Phil Alone that is full of news of the game development, new arts and a lot of other details!

[h3]Synopsis[/h3]

Phil Alone is a puzzle/horror game based on the old games “Escape The Room”. Phil should find out how to escape the death loop that he is in mysteriously, using the tips that he has in his room.

The initial production was done on a game jam and ended up becoming a huge product because of the players feedback that showed a lot of interest.

Translations were done in different languages and a lot of updates were created to improve the game to the maximum, bringing a better experience to the player.

The game’s release on Steam was only possible thanks to a small crowd funding. The game ended up reaching a huge quantity of downloads in 30 days, showing that a lot of players were interested in the proposal, because the feedback of Steam is found in a really positive way.
